adjustments.description: a group's work: members whose grade differs from the group's — a score of their own (replace) or plus or minus (delta), each with a reason — or none, taking away one carried from their earlier grade. Each member's adjustment is otherwise carried from their earlier grade on the work. A proposal records every member's, as it will be written (optional; omit or null)

kind.description: replace: a score of their own; delta: plus or minus the group's; none: no adjustment, taking away one carried from their earlier grade

points.description: replace: their score; delta: what is added to the group's score, below zero to take away (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5") (optional; omit or null)

reason.description: why, 1 to 500 characters: shown to the member, and kept (optional; omit or null)

allow_extra.description: permit a score above the points possible (optional; omit or null)

max.description: a decimal number; a string is accepted where exactness matters, with at most 40 digits either side of the point and an exponent of at most two digits (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5")

points.description: a decimal number; a string is accepted where exactness matters, with at most 40 digits either side of the point and an exponent of at most two digits (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5")

component_id.description: grade a directly graded component, such as an exam (optional; omit or null)

feedback_files.description: files to return with the grade, uploaded beforehand (optional; omit or null)

filename.description: the file's name, as it downloads: 1 to 255 characters on one line, a name and not a path; if omitted, the name given to document.upload_url, or else the title with its type's extension (optional; omit or null)

for_missing.description: whether the grade is for a 'missing' placeholder, nothing handed in; filled in when the grade is proposed, and the grade is refused if late work has since taken the placeholder's place (optional; omit or null)

members.description: a group's work: whose work it is, its members; if given, they must be. A proposal records them, and is refused on approval if they have changed (members_changed) (optional; omit or null)

no_rubric.description: that the grader was shown no rubric; filled in when the grade is proposed and no rubric is published, and the grade then records none, whatever is published before it is approved. A call giving it is refused if a rubric is published (optional; omit or null)

out_of.description: the points possible the score is out of; defaults to what the work is worth now. A proposal records it, and is refused on approval if the work has been rescaled since (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5") (optional; omit or null)

rubric_version_id.description: the rubric version the grader was shown; defaults to the published one. A proposal records it, or no_rubric if none was published when it was made (optional; omit or null)

score.description: a decimal number; a string is accepted where exactness matters, with at most 40 digits either side of the point and an exponent of at most two digits (a decimal number as a string, e.g. "87.5")

student_member_id.description: required with component_id (optional; omit or null)

submission_id.description: grade this submission; or give component_id and student_member_id (optional; omit or null)
